name: opengrand_install
description: opengrand_install: the one-file first install - ota_loader_v4 stage-0 + loader slot A pre-seeded with ota_stage1 (state 'C79L', seq 1, CONFIRMED: there is no older loader to fall back to) + main slot A pre-seeded with ota_main (state 'C79S', seq 1, unconfirmed: 3 tries, confirmed after ~60 s on). Later updates of both go over Bluetooth (slot B, seq 2).

patches.note: ota_loader_v4 stage-0, 4500 bytes, ends at va 0x40174ba8 (budget 0x40175fe0). Lands in the erased hole after loader copy #1.
End VA of loader copy #1 (FUN_400AA994: len = this - 0x400C0000). Extended so stage-0 and the root key are copied to SDRAM: 0x40173a04 -> 0x40176000 (the stage-1 window above is loaded by stage-0).

Per-device root key (32 B, git-ignored secrets/ota_key.bin, tools/ota_pack.py). Stage-0 verifies loader images with it; stage-1 v4.0 uses it for main images and the authenticated ops (REMOTE_PROTOCOL 10.3 / 10.12).

bne -> s0_h1 (0x40173a14). SysEx end handler: unknown manufacturer ID falls through to 0x40147E98. Stage-0 hands 0x7D to the running stage-1 and jumps to the same place for everything else (registers as they came).
bl -> s0_tick (0x40173a3c). Engine loop tail (task 24, ~8 ms). Stage-0 runs its boot step or the stage-1 tick and tail-calls the original 0x40142C90, whose return value the loop ignores.

loader A slot (NOR 0x601a0000) pre-seeded with ota_stage1.c79: state 'C79L' + seq 1 + state version 1, confirmed (+8 = 0000), the rest of the state area erased, the signed file at +0x200. The slot sectors lie in the erased hole of MainProgram that no stock copy reads (loader copy #1 ends at file 0x116000). Key-dependent (a signed .c79): the blob lives under the git-ignored build/.

main A slot (NOR 0x60180000) pre-seeded with ota_main.c79: state 'C79S' + seq 1 + state version 1, unconfirmed, the rest of the state area erased, the signed file at +0x200. The slot sectors lie in the erased hole of MainProgram that no stock copy reads (loader copy #1 ends at file 0x116000). Key-dependent (a signed .c79): the blob lives under the git-ignored build/.
